name: Fatima Raza
content: I needed a portfolio that would actually showcase my graphic design work the way it deserves. Hassnain delivered a stunning site with custom animations and Framer Motion transitions that make my work pop. Highly recommend.

name: James Whitfield
content: Hassnain developed our CO2 calculator platform with Next.js and Material UI. He understood the complexity of HVAC emission calculations and translated them into a clean, intuitive interface that our clients love using daily.

name: Sumera Shaikh
content: Hassnain built a professional website for our hostel that looks modern and works perfectly on mobile. He was patient with our feedback, made every change we asked for, and the final result helped us get more bookings online.

name: Hamza Siddiqui
content: Hassnain architected the Intentrixa Chrome extension from the ground up — DOM scanning, OpenAI integration, autonomous UI actions. His TypeScript skills and ability to handle complex browser APIs are seriously impressive.
